firstPlayerRule: Deal one numbered Help card to each player at random. Player 1 gets the First Player token.
clarifications: The Help card numbers also set the order for choosing Characters: Player 1 drafts first, then Player 2, and so on.
Starting with the first player and going clockwise, each player takes a turn of 2 Actions.
The First Player token passes to the left each round, except in the first turn of the game.

sources.title: Nemesis — Game Manual

internalEvidence: Downloaded the Nemesis English rulebook from nemesisgames.eu (Awaken Realms' Nemesis site) and extracted text from PDF pages 3, 8 and 10, whose printed page numbers match. Page 8 step 14: 'Take as many Help cards as there are players and deal one to each player at random. These cards determine the order of choosing'; step 19: 'Player 1 gets the First Player token.' Page 10: the token passes left each round but not in the first turn; turns go clockwise from the first player. The designer's note names Adam Kwapiński's game and Awaken Realms, matching base game BGG 167355. SHA-256: 361b7df733bd97f40df76ff002063433724fb0d96a3307de0171cdbb00f84ae2. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: No printed edition year was found in the extracted text.
In the optional Intruder-player mode, the Intruder player never takes the First Player token.
